channel.title: Integ Life Blog
channel.description: Bilingual field notes about productivity, personal systems, focused work, and AI-assisted execution.

item.title: Memory should have paths, not piles
item.description: Integ.Life Memory now combines an Inbox with Markdown file paths and collapsible folders, so notes can gain structure without slowing down capture.
item.author: Albert

item.title: A todo workspace should answer: what now?
item.description: The current Integ.Life Todo workspace separates Today, Tomorrow, This week, Overdue, and MIT so a large task system can still produce a clear next move.
item.author: Albert

item.title: One identity, many focused tools
item.description: Integ.Life now uses a central sign-in across its connected product family, while each product keeps a focused interface and an independent domain.
item.author: Albert

item.title: Let ChatGPT review the record without taking control
item.description: The Integ.Life ChatGPT Connector exposes authorized records through a read-only MCP connection, giving AI real context while keeping decisions and changes with the user.
item.author: Albert

item.title: A day inside my personal operating system
item.description: From morning intake, to ideas, todos, focus sessions, accounting, and ChatGPT review, a personal operating system is useful when the records of the day stay connected.
item.author: Albert

item.title: Turn scattered ideas into an executable system
item.description: A productivity system becomes useful when notes, comments, AI review, and todos stay connected instead of living in separate tools.
item.author: Albert

item.title: A focus timer should remember the work
item.description: Pomodoro sessions are more useful when they are attached to todos and become part of a real progress history.
item.author: Albert

item.title: Your productivity system has to follow the device you are using
item.description: Web, Mac, Android, and Wear OS each support a different capture moment, so the system needs offline-first continuity across them.
item.author: Albert

item.title: Goals need evidence, not slogans
item.description: Long-running goals become manageable when milestones, todos, focus sessions, and AI review form a visible execution trail.
item.author: Albert

item.title: A personal back office for independent work
item.description: Freelancers and self-directed workers need a lightweight way to connect time, money, follow-ups, ideas, and execution history.
item.author: Albert
